mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_order(team_id, activity_id, activity_name, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, target_count, lock_count, complete_count, status, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, create_time, update_time) values (#{teamId}, #{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{originalPrice}, #{deductionPrice}, #{payPrice}, #{targetCount}, #{lockCount}, #{completeCount}, #{status}, #{validStartTime}, #{validEndTime}, #{notifyType}, #{notifyMQ}, #{notifyUrl}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update group_buy_order set lock_count = lock_count + 1, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 0 and lock_count < target_count and valid_end_time > now()
mapper.select: select id, team_id, activity_id, activity_name, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, target_count, lock_count, complete_count, status, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, create_time, update_time from group_buy_order where team_id = #{teamId}
